entities.summary: Zouheir El Graoui is a Moroccan indoor and beach volleyball player. He is part of the Moroccan national team, and was a participant in the beach volleyball tournament at the Olympic Games Tokyo 2020. At the professional club level, he plays for PSG Stal Nysa.
